author: Linnaeus, 1766
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 우리나라에서는 보기 드문 나그네새로, 축축한 초원, 논, 못과 늪에서 지낸다. 밤에 활동하며 어류, 들쥐 같은 설치류, 새, 양서류, 갑각류, 곤충 따위를 먹는다. 갈대밭이나 초지에 수초로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 한 배에 알 4~5개를 낳는다. 유럽, 아시아, 북아메리카 등지에서 번식하고 열대 지방까지 내려가 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Purple Heron (Ardea purpurea), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean wetlands on spring passage (April–May): crown and two long slender nape plumes black; face, neck sides and hindneck rufous-chestnut, with a black stripe running from the gape down the whole side of the neck and black streaks down the buff-white front of the neck; back and wings dark slate-grey with long, loose chestnut-buff plumes on the scapulars; breast with long chestnut plumes; belly and flanks deep chestnut-maroon to blackish; thighs chestnut. Long, slender yellow bill with a darker upper ridge; yellow iris; long yellowish-brown legs with very long toes.
art.pose: standing motionless in a wet meadow, neck extended, watching for prey
art.scene: Korean marsh with wet grassland, ponds and rice paddies; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing in a wet meadow: black crown and nape plumes, rufous neck with a black stripe down its side, dark slate-grey back with long chestnut-buff scapular plumes, chestnut-maroon belly and flanks, long yellow bill, long yellowish legs

adult, head and neck detail: black crown with two long black nape plumes, rufous face and neck, black line from the gape down the neck side, black-streaked buff foreneck, slender yellow bill, yellow eye
art.build: Large, slender heron, 79cm long, a little smaller and much thinner than Grey Heron. Long, very thin, snake-like neck held in a sharp S-kink at rest and stretched out when stalking; small narrow head. Bill very long (much longer than the head), slender, straight and dagger-pointed. Legs long; toes notably long. Wingtips reach about the tail tip at rest; tail short. In flight neck retracted into a deep angular bulge below the body, long toes trailing and splayed; dark grey upperwing with blacker flight feathers, chestnut-maroon underwing coverts.
avoid: Do not paint a white or pale grey neck or a white crown — that is Grey Heron (Ardea cinerea).
Do not paint a thick neck or a short stout bill; the neck is thin and snake-like and the bill long and slender.
Do not paint white underparts; the belly and flanks are dark chestnut and black.
Do not paint a violet-purple body; despite the name the colours are rufous, slate-grey and chestnut.
